item.name: Coffee
item.price: Free from machine; about $55 in shop
item.effect: Restores 5% sanity per sip, up to 3 sips (15% total)
item.howToGet: Coffee machine near reception; also supplies shop or Robux. Used to calm Head Banger and some NPCs
item.cardSummary: Your main free sanity drink. Grab a cup between crises, and keep one ready for the Head Banger at the window.

item.name: Chocolate
item.effect: Restores 20% sanity per bite, up to 3 bites (60% total)
item.howToGet: Supplies shop or reception Robux option
item.cardSummary: A bigger sanity snack than coffee. Buy it when your meter is already in the danger zone.

item.name: Run Fast Cola
item.effect: Temporary movement speed boost for up to 30 seconds
item.howToGet: Supplies shop, vending near shop from shift 3, or Paramedic starter stock
item.cardSummary: Sprint fuel for cross-hospital emergencies. Paramedics start with a large cola stock.

item.name: Fire Extinguisher
item.effect: Puts out room fires and patients on fire; can also reveal ghosts, hiders, and slime
item.howToGet: Case near the supplies shop / check-in area after early shifts; return it to recharge
item.cardSummary: Required for fire emergencies. Also handy for spraying invisible threats into view.

item.name: Taser
item.price: About $150–$155; free box later; multi-use about $250
item.effect: Stuns anomalies, shapeshifters, and hostile patients at close range
item.howToGet: Supplies shop, recharge box in reception, or Security starter X-Taser
item.cardSummary: The default answer for hostile patients and many rituals. Keep it charged instead of only carrying treatments.

item.name: Gun
item.effect: Ranged takedown of anomalies and enemies; limited ammo
item.howToGet: Supplies shop, reception Robux option, or Secret Agent starter
item.cardSummary: High power, limited ammo. Best when you expect shapeshifters or ghosts and do not want to close the gap.

item.name: Teddy Bear
item.effect: Revives a downed teammate (cannot self-revive)
item.cardSummary: Co-op insurance. Expensive, but it is the item that brings a dead teammate back into the shift.

item.name: DNA Analysis Upgrade
item.effect: +50% DNA analysis speed (roughly halves the wait)
item.cardSummary: Shortens the diagnosis wait in medical rooms. One of the first upgrades worth buying every run.

item.name: Printer Upgrade
item.effect: +25% printer speed
item.cardSummary: Speeds photo and paperwork steps at check-in. Helpful once the desk is the bottleneck.

item.name: Patient Recovery Speed
item.effect: +25% patient recovery speed
item.cardSummary: Patients clear beds faster, which opens rooms during busy ambulance waves.

item.name: Patient Check-in Upgrade
item.effect: Faster check-in by skipping the initial “…” dialogue
item.cardSummary: Cheap desk QoL. Buy early so reception does not waste seconds on every patient.

item.name: Check-in Window Upgrade
item.effect: Adds a second check-in window for two patients at once
item.cardSummary: Doubles reception throughput. Essential once ambulance waves and late shifts stack arrivals.

item.name: Herbs
item.effect: Cures headaches
item.cardSummary: Match the DNA result for headaches. Free treatment stock is always by the rooms.

item.name: Medicine
item.effect: Cures stomach aches
item.cardSummary: Standard cure for stomach issues after DNA diagnosis.

item.name: Thermometer
item.effect: Cures fever
item.cardSummary: Use when diagnosis shows fever. Keep one in inventory on busy shifts.

item.name: Medkit
item.effect: Cures bruises; also used in some surgery requests
item.cardSummary: Wound care for bruise results and a common Room 8 surgery deliverable.

item.name: Ointment
item.effect: Cures burns and rashes; needed after putting a patient out by hand
item.cardSummary: Burn care for normal patients and for anyone you extinguished without a full extinguisher clear.

item.name: Bandage
item.effect: Cures bleeding; also used in some surgery requests
item.cardSummary: Apply when diagnosis lists bleeding as the problem.

item.name: Cough Syrup
item.effect: Cures flu symptoms; also cleans slime faster
item.cardSummary: Flu patients need cough syrup after diagnosis. Bonus use for slime cleanups.

item.name: Maple Syrup
item.effect: Cures low sugar and Canadian; also feeds the Bed Monster
item.cardSummary: Double duty item. Treat low sugar patients, and keep a bottle ready for bed grabs.

item.name: Eye Drops
item.effect: Cures dry eyes; calms Mass of Eyes; can clear death-ritual candles
item.cardSummary: Eye care with emergency side uses against ceiling eyes and some ritual candle clears.

item.name: IV Drops
item.effect: Cures dehydration; starts Room 8 surgery prep; can clear death-ritual candles
item.cardSummary: Dehydration cure that also starts surgery sequences and can help stop rituals.

item.name: Scalpel
item.effect: Surgery mini-game tool; can be given to Barney in some encounters
item.cardSummary: Deliver when Room 8 surgery asks for a scalpel during the timed rounds.

item.name: Scissors
item.effect: Surgery mini-game tool
item.cardSummary: Another Room 8 surgery tool. Follow the blackboard request each round.

item.name: Organ
item.effect: Surgery mini-game tool; can also feed the Bed Monster
item.cardSummary: Surgery component with a side use as Bed Monster bait if maple syrup is missing.

item.name: Transplant
item.effect: Surgery mini-game tool; can also feed the Bed Monster
item.cardSummary: Late surgery delivery item. Also works as Bed Monster feed alongside maple syrup.
